{"lines":[{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928017971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"河","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928017971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍負圖者，非圖也，乃大⿔也。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928017971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其背上所有之紋，一長畫，二短畫，一白點近尾，九紫點近頸，四碧㸃在肩之左，二黑㸃在肩之右，六白㸃近足之右，八白㸃近足之左，三緑㸃近脇之左，七赤㸃在脇之右，五黃點在背之中，凡九所而七色焉。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928034355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羲皇","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928050739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以九位而定方，以一長畫、二短畫而生爻，以三才而設位，","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928050739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928050739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道由是而生矣。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928050739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928083507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洛馬","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928083507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出書之初，有一白㸃、六黑點，在北近尾；七白點、二黑㸃在背近頭；","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928083507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三白㸃","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928083507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"、","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928083507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928083507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑㸃在背之左；","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928083507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九白㸃","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928083507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"、四黑㸃在背之右，五白㸃在背之中。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928083507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大撓","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928099891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定之，一六在下，合于北，生水，亥子属焉；二七在上，合于南，生火，巳午属焉；三八在左，合于東，生木，寅卯属焉；四九在右，合于西，生金，申酉属焉；五十在中，合于中，生土，辰戌丑未属焉。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928099891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四維也，斯地之氣也，重濁焉。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928116275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533867202815033359"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"𡊮天綱推六十甲子納音法","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928132659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄帝","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928149043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928149043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大撓","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928149043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"探五行之精，占斗罡所建，始作","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928149043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928149043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，乃定天幹十字属河之圖，一白生戊，二黑生乙癸，三緑生庚，四碧生辛，六白生壬甲，七赤生","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928149043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928149043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，八白生丙，九紫生己，而天幹成焉。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928149043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定地枝十二属","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928165427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洛","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928165427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之書，以天一生水，地六成之，合于北方，亥子属焉；天七生火，地二成之，合于南方，巳午属焉；天三生木，地八成之，合于東方，寅卯属焉；天九生金，地四成之，合于西方，申酉属焉。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928165427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天五生土，地十成之，合于中宫，辰成丑未属焉，而地枝定焉。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928181811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又以天干地支綜而為","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六十","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子，而納音所属，則本於","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太元數","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"云：甲己子午九，","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未八，","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辛","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申七，","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁壬","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯酉六，","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊癸","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533867202815049743"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五，","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取奇數九七五而倍之生律，故律四十二；取偶數八六四而倍之生吕，故吕三十六。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928214579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"併律吕之數凡七十有八，黃鍾之數生焉。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928230963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其為度也，皆本黄，而八音生焉。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928247347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"納音實参諸此。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928263731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一六生水，水本無音，遇土數五十則有音；二七為火，火本無音，遇水數一與六則有音。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928280115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖以土擊水，以水激火，相勝而成音故也。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928296499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三八為木，四九為金，如木遇木數，金遇金數，則兩木兩金相擊，自能成音。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928312883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五十為土，則取二七火數，盖火能陶土成器，而後有音也。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928329267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九恬裕齋","logicSentenceId":"7538009345793179674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533867202816196623"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁，火也，壬癸，水也。","logicSentenceId":"7538009345793179674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁惡壬癸者，壬癸為丙丁之鬼，生於","logicSentenceId":"7538009345793196058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋冬，則壬癸旺相之時，丙丁包絕之時，號為鬼𦔽身衰，其阻","logicSentenceId":"7538009345793196058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"障得尤切。","logicSentenceId":"7538009345793196058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生於春夏，則壬癸包絶，丙丁𦔽相，號為身旺鬼，","logicSentenceId":"7538009345793212442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"哀其阻障不得。","logicSentenceId":"7538009345793212442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙，木也，庚辛金也。","logicSentenceId":"7538009345793228826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙喜庚辛者，庚辛為","logicSentenceId":"7538009345793245210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙之官，生於春冬，則𢈏辛包絕之時，甲乙𦔽相之時，號為","logicSentenceId":"7538009345793245210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺官，哀其主爵禄不𩔰。","logicSentenceId":"7538009345793245210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是生於夏秋，則庚辛却得旺，甲乙","logicSentenceId":"7538009345793261594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"包絶，號為身衰官旺，其主爵 {"lines":[{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533867202816540687"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲人戊癸本非殊，或加從革應相呼。","logicSentenceId":"7538038832722706478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四位土支逢一二，祿𫝗","logicSentenceId":"7538038832722722862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"權清出帝都。","logicSentenceId":"7538038832722722862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用真火生其土，有戊無癸，以子代之；有癸無戊，以已代之。","logicSentenceId":"7538038832722739246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子已","logicSentenceId":"7538038832722755630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃土成實之地。","logicSentenceId":"7538038832722755630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已酉丑","logicSentenceId":"7538038832722772014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福元旺水生焉，辰戌丑未四","logicSentenceId":"7538038832722772014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土若逢一二位，為成實之格，子已代戊癸。","logicSentenceId":"7538038832722772014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲人有戊癸合","logicSentenceId":"7538038832722788398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子癸己，辰戌丑未，最貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7538038832722788398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雲漢","logicSentenceId":"7538038832722804782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秀氣。","logicSentenceId":"7538038832722804782","marginNoteIdL {"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行者，徃來乎天地之間而不窮者也，是故謂之行。","logicSentenceId":"7538012427763204105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"北方隂極","logicSentenceId":"7538012427763220489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而生寒，寒生水；南方陽極而生𤍠，𤍠生火；東方陽散而生風，風","logicSentenceId":"7538012427763220489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生木；西方隂止以收而生燥，燥生金；中央隂陽交而生温，温生","logicSentenceId":"7538012427763220489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土。","logicSentenceId":"7538012427763220489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其相生也，所以相維；其相尅也，所以相治，此之謂有倫。","logicSentenceId":"7538012427763236873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五行要論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論金○春忌見木，不能克伐；夏忌見火，金嫌鬼盛；秋忌見金，太","logicSentenceId":"7538012427763253257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剛則闕，旺則害物；冬忌見水，水流則金化。","logicSentenceId":"7538012427763253257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金成則火煉，器就，是金成則欲得火金木。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"成則不欲火也。又云：秋金得火方為良。金到","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"已酉丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"尔，可謂之成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：金不煉，不成器。","logicSentenceId":"7538012427763269641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18 {"lines":[{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873437468885007"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行足格，","logicSentenceId":"7538012427897913371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂年月日時胎，五行排成，若無衝破空亡、死絶，更有福神互為","logicSentenceId":"7538012427897913371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之助。","logicSentenceId":"7538012427897913371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行入庫，取為上格，貴極一品。","logicSentenceId":"7538012427897929755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖不入庫，則生旺亦可，然","logicSentenceId":"7538012427897946139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不及入庫為貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7538012427897946139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又不入庫，不生旺，只純粹不駁雜，亦可為兩","logicSentenceId":"7538012427897962523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"府。","logicSentenceId":"7538012427897962523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"純粹不駁雜者，無死絕、衝破、空亡耳。","logicSentenceId":"7538012427897978907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有絶死，即從减論，然有","logicSentenceId":"7538012427897995291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"他𠁅納音救之，亦可為兩府制。","logicSentenceId":"7538012427897995291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然破多難。","logicSentenceId":"7538012427898011675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其履歴須反覆進退，","logicSentenceId":"753801242789 {"lines":[{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873437468983311"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之用也。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683573810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"体生於己，乗父母之祿；用生於申，繼父母之位而生","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683590194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683590194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"李虚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"中書。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推其形色，則水黑、火赤、木青、金白、土黃，此五行之正色也。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683606578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及其","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683622962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變易則不然。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683622962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常以生旺從正色，","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683639346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"常生旺，則正氣全，可見正色。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死絶從母色，","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683639346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木之母也，死絶則黑；木者，火之母也，死絶則青；火者，土之母也，則死絶則赤；土者，金之母也，死絶則黃。夫五行死絕，則氣歸根見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"於母之地。凢人之遇苦楚而呻吟母者，乃其義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成形冠帶從妻色，","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683639346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"幼壮之年，及衰老之際，之即妻之時也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病敗從鬼色，","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683639346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"病敗之地，是鬼狂之鄉，受尅則氣歸鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683639346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓從子色。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683639346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"𦔽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"為傳墓，為歛藏，故色在於子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其數則水一、火二，木三，金四、土五，旺生加倍，死絶减半。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683655730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以義","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683672114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推之。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683672114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"燭神經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行旺相囚休死例","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683688498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"恬裕","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683688498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"齋：","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683688498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873437468999695"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春木旺，火相金囚，水休土死；夏火旺，土相水囚，木休金死；","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683688498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋金旺，水相火囚，土休木死；冬水旺，木相土囚，金休火死。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683688498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論曰：五行當時者旺，所生者相，所尅者死，主我者休，尅我","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683704882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者囚。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683704882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨土無旺，金無相，水無死，火無休，木無囚，此其何故","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683721266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也？","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683721266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖一朞之日，三百六十，五行均旺七十二日，惟土為萬","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683737650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物母，各旺四季一十八曰。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683737650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃帝","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683754034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：土於長夏時土旺，金相","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683754034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水死，火休木囚可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683754034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"閻東叟","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683770418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"云：推命尤須詳此，則凶","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683770418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者或吉，吉者或凶。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683770418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛己","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683786802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683786802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683786802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，是劫殺六害死，則凶者或","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683786802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683786802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683803186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫論五行之性，各致其用，水者其性智，火者其性禮，木者其性","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669574707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仁，金者其性義。","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669574707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"建者夫土則信而已，重厚寛博，無所不容。","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669591091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以之","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669607475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水，則水附之而行，以之木，則木托之而生。","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669607475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金不得土則無自出，","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669623859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火不得土則無自歸，必損實以為通，致虚以為明也。","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669623859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫論五行之用，多則太過，少則不及，其氣其數，有餘不足，皆能","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669640243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"致凶。","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669640243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"抑揚歸中，然後為福。","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669656627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"功成者貴於退藏也，將來者貴於荣","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669673011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"振也。","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669673011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"功成者，謂五行禀旺者也。","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669689395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺而能止息，是謂退藏。","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669705779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"將來者，五","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669722163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873438444847139"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行在冠帶胎飬之地，其氣𧇊而未盈，故欲子母相生，以益其","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669722163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，則有榮進振發之道也。","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669722163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如木非其時則狷介，","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669738547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"衰則為梗介，死絶則枯槁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"故為梗介。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金旺太過則動凶。","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669738547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"炎炎者貴乎熄，不熄則有自焚之灾；","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669754931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滔滔者貴乎止，不止則有自溺之患。","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669754931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫火行南陸而化𤍠，盛","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669771315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則焚烈而害物，至酉亥，則隂能翕之，然後温煖。","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669771315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水行北陸而","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590379017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化寒，盛則嚴冷而殺物，至夘已，則陽能闢之，然後滋生萬物。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590379017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言水火止熄則和也。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590395401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂不得陽，則沉滔而不興；陽不得","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590411785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂，則燥進而不復。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590411785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫五行之性，大槩以胎生旺庫為四貴，死絶、病敗為四忌，餘為","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590428169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四平。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590428169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然有生而不生，旺而不旺者，此為凶，乃先吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590444553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有死而不","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590460937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"海虞","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590460937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590460937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瞿氏","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590460937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"藏本","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590460937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873438444863523"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死絕而不絶者，此為吉，乃先凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590460937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如水見戊申土，此生而不生也；水見見𢈏子土，此旺而不旺","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590477321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590477321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇此多成而反敗，因喜而反憂。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590493705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如水見","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590510089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590510089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夘金，此死而不","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590510089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死也；水見","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590510089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛已","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590510089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金，此絶而不絶也。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590510089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行氣盡，而得父母之得，","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590526473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以生益之，則其氣復生矣。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590526473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇之者，危中有福，窮而通，屈而伸","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590542857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590542857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生𦔽太過，則福中藏禍；死絶太過，則福無可託。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590559241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫死絕逢子，","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590575625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殃變能逃。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590575625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火土最先，金水有後，火絶得土曰𥈠，𥈠作聖。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590592009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火以土為子，火絶於亥，而見","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590608393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁亥","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590608393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590608393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又得土，則藏性於土","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590624777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，思而致道者也。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590624777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此絶火為清明復生之火，見","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590641161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590641161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥有氣之","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590641161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二恬裕齋","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590641161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873438444879907"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土，是為精思而所感皆通，𥈠則作聖矣。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590641161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土絶在已，得辛巳金是也。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590673929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金者，赤土也，是土之成器者，但生","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590690313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於土，而别於土也。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590690313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傳氣而成金，雖死而不亡也。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590706697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金絶得水，精復繼體。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590723081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金絕於寅，得甲寅水是也。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590739465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金，有氣也，絶於水者，精也。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590755849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水至寅","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590772233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夘為精嗇之地，然精嗇則全，精全則神應氣化而形復於本","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590772233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590772233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水絶得木，䰟復天逰。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590788617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水絶於木，已得已已木是也。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590805001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水者，精也，絶則精丧，則神離，氣","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590821385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873438444896291"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"散而形消，可謂凶矣。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590821385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然木主䰟，能從神而往來者，謂之魂，得","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590837769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"性歸真，隨體離形，同於大道者也。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590837769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木絶得火，火出木燼，灰飛煙滅，故獨為凶。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590854153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇馬無膽，於馬足證。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590870537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木絶於申，得丙申火是也。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590886921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖木資火水土之性，假合而生，脉","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590903305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"絶而枯槁，則還水也。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590903305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"灼之而為火，則還火也；腐之而為土，則","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590919689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"還土也。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590919689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡形失性，故獨為凶。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590936073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇馬者，在位已午，木歴已午而","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590952457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590952457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木者於藏属肝，於腑属膽，故蛇馬無膽，木證木死為凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590968841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"並","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590985225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"燭神經","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590985225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590985225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行之内闕土神，無救無療。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590985225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行之中，推土者，萬物之母也，水火金木因之以入命中得","logicSentenceId":"7537950324591001609","marginNoteIdList":n {"lines":[{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行之内，火雖畏水，火不得水，則又不能濟物；木雖畏金，非","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434766858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金則又不能成器。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434766858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火人得水者，在格曰未濟，言其終得濟也。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434783242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木人得金者，在格曰斵輪，言其終得用也。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434799626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火少水多者，火之","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434816010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勢不及於水，乃畏其水也。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434816010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金寡而木衆者，金之勢不及於木，","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434832394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃困於木也。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434832394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金火全名鑄印，犯丑字即為損模；木金等謂斵輪，向秋生而為","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434848778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷斧。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434848778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金亦兩得，火亦兩得，在格謂之鑄印，惟惡見丑字，盖鑄印必","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434865162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"藉土為模，辰、戌丑未皆土也，丑為破壊之字，得之者，乃𨮾印","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434865162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873438445125667"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"損模，模既損，則火散金消，反致殃矣。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434865162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木亦兩得，金亦兩得，在","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434881546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格謂之斵輪，偏惡秋生，盖秋為肅殺之時，乃斵輪傷斧；斧既","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434881546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷，則木弱金闕，反致殃矣。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434881546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"並","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壺中子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水火相濟，則精神具足；金木互用，則仁桑義剛。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434897930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水者，精也，火者，神也。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434914314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二物相濟，故精神明靈而具足。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434930698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金剛而","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434947082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木弱，桑二物互用，則仁義剛桑而兩相得矣。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434947082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"燭神經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論其眷属，憂其死絕。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434963466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瑩和尚","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434979850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"注云：生我者為父母，我生者為子孫，尅我者為官鬼，","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434979850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我尅者為妻財，比和者為兄弟。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434979850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"慮在空亡之地，憂居休囚死","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434996234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"絕之鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434996234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873438445142051"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三命鈴云：生我者為祿，我生者為庫，我尅者為財，尅我者為","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435012618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435012618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如金以土為妻，水為庫，木為財，火為鬼，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435029002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"值病憂病，逢生得生，旺相崢嶸，休囚絶滅。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435045386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瑩和尚","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435061770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"注云：值病憂病，以休囚絶滅為言；逢生得生，以旺相","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435061770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"崢嶸為義。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435061770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"值病憂病者，五行病中逢鬼也。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435078154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如木值","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435094538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435094538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己金，火","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435094538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"值","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435094538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435094538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水，土遇","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435094538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435094538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅木，金逢","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435094538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435094538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火，如此之類，旺相崢嶸。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435094538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435110922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢之氷嵗運，或值之鎡基。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435110922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更看始終，隨宜消息。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435127306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父病推其子孫，妻灾課以夫年。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435143690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瑩和尚","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435160074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"注云：五行相生為父子，隂陽相制為夫妻。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435160074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435176458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435176458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435176458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無疑，畏火急求以救之。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435176458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖金生水為子，水尅火故也。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435192842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如金","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435209226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873438445158435"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"灾者，恐值火也，且看火之休旺如何。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435209226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖尅我者為夫，此乃救","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435225610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"解二法，最為詳要。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435225610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王氏","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435241994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"注云：如丙寅火人見戊申土，火雖病","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435241994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而為戊申之父，雖病而戊申土長生，父丞子祿之䕃，雖病而","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435241994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不至於死也。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435241994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或丁卯火見甲午金為妻，金至午敗，可謂妻灾","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435258378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435258378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435274762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435274762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火旺在午，又逢祿，金火相傳，隂陽相合，而生造化，","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435274762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂妻隨夫貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435274762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡人胎數長，壽亦必長；胎數短，夀必短。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267756059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常以夀胎隔零數","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267772443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為夀限，遇德却於零數増之，遇殺於零數減之。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267772443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如正月生，四","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267788827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月受胎，此舉大綱，不必堅執其月，隨其閏行，但於受胎月尋。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267788827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"恬裕齋","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267805211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1162","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873439355125812"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神白經","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267805211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"云：或有不足月生者，或有出月生者，如何取的？","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267805211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：不","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267821595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267821595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胎月者，乃天地父母會而始合造化之月也。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267837979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物豈無始，徃","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267854363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"往不曾窮其奥㫖，得其妙論，所以失也。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267854363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"術曰：受胎之日與所","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267870747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生之日，為天地合，人乃方生。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267870747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若受胎之月，無此是日，故有出","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267887131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月也。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267887131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又術曰：胎與四柱交併，即有異毋。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267903515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太乙","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267919899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"降誕實經引","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267919899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甘氏經","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267919899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"云：胎與生日支干合，為受胎日與受胎月，尋其日辰。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267919899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若月内無，則推一兩月尋之。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267936283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論受氣，","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267952667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人受天地隂陽之氣，形體具足然後生，故在胎三百日乃成，","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267952667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則胎中所受之氣，安得不論。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267952667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如納音属金年懷胎，即受金氣","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267969051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873439355142196"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為形，或次年屬木，即受金木氣也，故遇金木氣得地。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267969051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267985435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267985435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑年三月","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267985435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"受胎，至","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267985435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次年","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267985435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267985435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅正月初一","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267985435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二間生，安得便作火","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267985435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命看？","logicSentenceId":"7538046019267985435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金氣多而火氣淺故也。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268001819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是須通逹造化之理，然後可以","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268018203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"語此。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268018203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今市卜者止據古人歌訣推論，所以多不準也。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268034587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予自得","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268050971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此說於一老先生，以此論命，多得人四柱所不可推𠁅。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268050971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或云","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268067355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勿用胎元者，其謬論耳。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268067355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：胎氣不深者，不能耐久，廢即易","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268083739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"休。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268083739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更看納音如何。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268100123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂如金年受胎，逢土年生即好，若金年受","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268116507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胎，火年生，即不堅固也。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268116507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：胎月見貴，必受福䕃。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268132891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"希尹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"書。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"郭景初","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268149275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"引","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268149275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陳昉","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268149275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"說云：足求胎月遇貴者，若今受胎，","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268149275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今年","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268149275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生者，","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268149275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隨今年太𡻕干求之。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268149275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若去年受胎，","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268165659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今年","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268165659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生者，隨去年太嵗干。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268165659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268182043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"恬裕齋","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268182043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873439355158580"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求之，胎月遇去年貴者，差慢於","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268182043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今年","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268182043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268182043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268198427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"康子祥","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268198427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：雖","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268198427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"去年受胎，便以","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268198427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今年","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268198427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗干為主，未知孰是。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268198427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡推胎月，知人貴盛者，謂驛馬建祿在胎月也。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268214811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令甲子人","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268231195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十月生，胎月在寅，甲子人祿馬俱在寅，又寅與亥合，是月生","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268231195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與胎月祿馬俱合也。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268231195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又陽命男順行為向祿馬，干祿至亥為","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268247579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長生，支命到亥為臨官。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268247579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此人三十己前必超越，但亥上是空","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268263963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡，少年多厄。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268263963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若胎月在驛馬後二辰，亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268280347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268296731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁亥","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268296731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人十一","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268296731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月生，以亥人驛馬在已，二月受胎，是馬後二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268296731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又祿干是丁","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268313115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火，十一月生，建祿胎也。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268313115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"他準此推之。","logicSentenceId":"7538046019268329499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1249","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三命指掌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若重重有納音秀者，亦有祿而不","logicSentenceId":"7538010109848436774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至𩔰耀也。","logicSentenceId":"7538010109848436774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若傷損時德，鬼氣大甚，有破害、衝廢多者，濁之甚也，","logicSentenceId":"7538010109848453158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是無禄貧下之命。","logicSentenceId":"7538010109848453158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若損德不多，或為官格，終是君子中隱小人","logicSentenceId":"7538010109848469542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7538010109848469542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或有引無用，有用無引，却分中末限有無也。","logicSentenceId":"7538010109848485926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八恬裕齋","logicSentenceId":"7538000318191484974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873439356305460"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人主官爵髙貴，若見胎月，必見祖隂，有禄馬，必見天乙，必無","logicSentenceId":"7538000318191484974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"科名。","logicSentenceId":"7538000318191484974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生時見貴，有禄有馬，位極人臣，惟忌無氣。","logicSentenceId":"7538000318191501358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如貴人属火而","logicSentenceId":"7538000318191517742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生冬月，雖有如無。","logicSentenceId":"7538000318191517742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"玉霄寳鑑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人","logicSentenceId":"7538000318191534126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨禄，上將相之徵，與馬同宫，必作公卿，與","logicSentenceId":"7538000318191534126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太","logicSentenceId":"7538000318191534126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"崴相食。","logicSentenceId":"7538000318191534126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴神","logicSentenceId":"7538000318191550510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無氣，又是空亡，則無力。","logicSentenceId":"7538000318191550510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"li {"lines":[{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若寅生人月日時遇甲，","logicSentenceId":"7538029179804287026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘準此。","logicSentenceId":"7538029179804287026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇兩重已上，又在四貴華蓋之位，則極貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7538029179804303410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在四","logicSentenceId":"7538029179804319794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平位或貴人上，亦主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7538029179804319794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：崴干官正印尤佳。","logicSentenceId":"7538029179804336178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在四忌上，則亦","logicSentenceId":"7538029179804352562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七恬裕齋","logicSentenceId":"7538029179804352562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873440386727970"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有官常調之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7538029179804352562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三命提要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"建祿者，主人肌厚氣實，韻格不清，一生安逸，足則財，此生旺者","logicSentenceId":"7538029179804368946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然也。","logicSentenceId":"7538029179804368946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死絕則氣濁神慢孜孜為生吝嗇猥鄙。","logicSentenceId":"7538029179804385330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pin {"lines":[{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡祿命、身三等官，各禀五行，率以其性推之。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440561190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以金為官，","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440577574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主職位清峻，多掌刑獄錢穀之任，决斷明敏。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440577574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇行年太歲在丑。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440593958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873440387711010"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為官庫主喜，亦取旺相休敗、有氣無氣言之，餘凖此。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440610342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以木為","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440626726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官，主品秩清髙，和裕守慎。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440626726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇行年太𡻕在未為官庫，以火為官，","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440643110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主官序炎赫，為性猛烈，用刑惨酷，亦主發歇不常。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440643110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"過行年太𡻕","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440659494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在戌為官庫，以水為官，主職畀位下，級陞序進，謙和得衆，矜恤","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440659494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孤寡，亦有道性。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440659494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"過。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440675878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行年太嵗至辰為官庫，以土為官，主官序隱","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440692262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"審，難侵犯，厚重質直，法令分明。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440692262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇行年太嵗至辰為官庫。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440708646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡五","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440725030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行之官，各隨其性則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440725030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金主義，主綱，木主文，主仁，火主禮，主猛，","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440741414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水主智，主順，土主信、主重。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440741414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若各失其性，則主為官不久，禍咎生","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440757798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"焉。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440757798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440774182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440774182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木命，人以土為祿官，木為命官，金為身官，盖取尅","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440774182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我者為官，餘命準此。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440774182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有所損丁遇兩壬之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441019942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又須四貴華蓋上遇正官者，主大","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441036326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441036326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四平","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441036326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次之。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441036326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"並三命提要：","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441052710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"真官時遇，早達金紫之封；日遇真官，貴則時加祿命。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441052710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時日生遇","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441069094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官印，須慿有氣之鄉，若遇衝空亡，此等遇如不遇也。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441069094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官印遇鬼，","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441085478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官印如無，鬼旺鬼衰，詳其勝負。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441085478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官刑命喜，莫教命反刑官。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441101862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官印","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441118246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"受刑，縱貴不戎，即吏官印明無暗有。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441118246","marginNoteIdList":null," {"lines":[{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財綬者，盖以𡻕制月建，如甲乙人在辰戌丑未，丙丁人在申酉，","logicSentenceId":"7538037681931714610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873441351729186"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘凖此。","logicSentenceId":"7538037681931714610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若人遇之，主職位崇髙，印綬𩔰赫，","logicSentenceId":"7538037681931730994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"並三命鈐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但看財庫有氣，逢背祿而不貧苦也。","logicSentenceId":"7538037681931730994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財絶命衰，縱建祿而不富。","logicSentenceId":"7538037681931747378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
