{"lines":[{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金神大殺者，至凶之神。","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613378094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古人云：寅申已亥，雞頭粉碎；四支生人，","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613394478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873442388508724"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金神在酉，子午夘酉，蛇頭開口；四支生人，金神在已，辰戌丑未","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613394478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"牛頭大忌。","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613394478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四支生人，金神在丑，與人為灾而不為福，又主䘮服","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613410862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"哭泣之事。","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613410862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑人金殺在本命，若生月曰時，又在丑上，帶鬼尅身，","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613427246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則有不測之禍。","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613427246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613443630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉丑","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613443630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金之位，故金人居於上，所值金神，更","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613443630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶金火，則為灾又大而遲。","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613443630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三命提要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金殺者，謂五行中惟金為殺物，一殺而有三名也。","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613460014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一曰吟神殺，","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613476398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二曰破碎殺，三曰白衣殺。","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613476398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其神常居在","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613492782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613492782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉丑三位，盖是金之","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613492782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"躰也。","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613492782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申已亥在酉，子午卯酉在已，辰戊丑未在丑，是金之生","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613509166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺庫也。","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613509166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在已曰吟神，已中臨官之火，火者，金之官也，金氣臨尅，","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613525550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主官符杖楚、刑獄呻吟之災，故曰吟神。","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613525550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在酉曰破碎，酉者金旺","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613541934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873442388525108"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之地，殺物當時，又有辛金 {"lines":[{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在丑曰白衣，乃金庫墓也，居四季而臨","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613558318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼門，主妨害䘮服哭泣之事，故曰白衣。","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613558318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其神生旺，主人寛量大","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613574702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"器，决㫁有能，形容清峻。","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613574702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不夭䘮刑傷，則須有癩病癱患；死絶","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613591086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則𢡖害尅毒，形容紅白，巧言令色，笑裡藏刀。","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613591086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其神常主橫事。","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613607470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613623854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官符併，則主橫來官灾；與刼殺併，則横来死䘮；與白虎羊刃併","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613623854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"併，則流血傷殘；與貴人建禄併，則稍慢。","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613623854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行旺相，不稍用也。","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613640238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"燭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神經","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613656622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"：","logicSentenceId":"7538015004613656622","marginNoteIdList":n {"lines":[{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅","logicSentenceId":"7538016296173355018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯辰孤，已寡，丑，已午未孤，申寡，辰，","logicSentenceId":"7538016296173355018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申酉戌孤亥寡，未，亥子丑孤寅寡戌。","logicSentenceId":"7538016296173355018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三命纂局","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逐方三位，進前一辰為孤，退後一辰為寡。","logicSentenceId":"7538016296173371402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進為陽不利父，退","logicSentenceId":"7538016296173387786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為隂不利母。","logicSentenceId":"7538016296173387786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：在陽宫主妨父，在隂宫主妨母。","logicSentenceId":"7538016296173404170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常術云：男","logicSentenceId":"7538016296173420554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌孤辰，女忌寡宿，其神形孤骨露，面無和氣，生旺稍可，死絕","logicSentenceId":"7538016296173420554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873442388639796"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無倚，與䘮門弔客併者，一生多𮞸重䘮叠禍，自身纔發，則骨","logicSentenceId":"7538016296173420554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肉伶行也。","logicSentenceId":"7538016296173420554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"燭神經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList" {"lines":[{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡貧賤之命，多無貴，或五行死絶，支干閑慢，不相干涉，此為貧","logicSentenceId":"7538011398104137755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賤之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398104137755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命中多見死絶者，一生少得足意事，資財窘闕，憂煎逼迫之","logicSentenceId":"7538011398104154139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人也。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398104154139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命祿落空亡，大耗尅身，天中臨日，本命無氣，一生破財，貧賤","logicSentenceId":"7538011398104170523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398104170523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命一位上聚諸祿馬生旺，而却天中臨之，或有他位来刑害，","logicSentenceId":"7538011398104186907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於氣散者，窮悴薄福之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398104186907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命中五位死絕，或落空亡，驛馬出尅，身離鄉背，并困窮之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398104203291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873442388951092"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命見辰戌丑未相尅，五行無氣而不激揚，位位逢合，支千閑","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287130650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"慢者，奴賤命也。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287130650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡貧賤之名，常用建祿、食神為救神，命中有此二救，雖貧而不","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287147034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"致困餓，一遇運發，却小小稱意，運過則傷貧賤也。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287147034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡欲知凶惡者，乃命與五行無氣，而又相尅，支千乖戾刑衝，互","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287163418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為凌戰帶殺是也。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287163418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命見真衝氣散，或真刑氣散者，多是廢疾之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287179802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命見官符大耗刑尅本命，五刑死絶，全然無救者，一生多官","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287196186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"灾屈辱汗濁，貧賤受制於人也。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287196186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命見官符尅身，或兩木相刑衝，平生主官事杖楚之灾也。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287212570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873442388967476"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命見辰戌丑未，魁罡相衝，全無貴人、驛馬相𦔳者，孤凶惡配","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287228954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逺方人也。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287228954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命五行死絶無氣，相尅䖏，不宜見天水、火溺、白虎、自縊、一切","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287245338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惡殺，决是不令終之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287245338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命見五行皆旺，而却位位相尅，氣散者，多暴死人也。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287261722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若帶諸","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287278106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺，多是橫死夭亡、兵刃、誤水火而終之命也。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287278106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命見交互空亡、孤寡四殺者，殍死路傍人也。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287294490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命見破碎白虎、羊刀相尅者，不以貴賤，死須破屍也。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287310874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命見天中重疊相尅者，必不見屍也。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287327258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命見天中大耗、刼殺同宫者，必有賤名不良之行，更或五行","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287343642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873442388983860"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑尅，帶白虎、羊刃之𩔖，是刼盗刑戮而終也。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287343642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡凶惡之格，常須貴人、三奇、華盖夾貴而救神有此四神相肋，","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287360026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖見凶神，不至切害。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287360026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大忌者，五行閑慢，死絶而無建祿神，三才","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287376410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑尅，帶殺而無貴氣相遇，則其為貧賤凶惡不能免也。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287376410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"並","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"燭神經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賊凶","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287392794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱皆相應，更臨虚廢地，當居賊處中，而向刑中死。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287392794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"玉門関","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"集","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瑩和尚","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287441946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"注云：初生歇滅而晚𡻕興隆者，源濁流清之謂也；幼","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287441946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年建旺而臨老竛褥者，根甜裔苦之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287441946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873442389000244"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"若乃尊凶𤰞吉救療無功尊吉畢凶逢灾自愈","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287458330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瑩和尚","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287474714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"注云：立年尊，其胎月日時資以次之，大運為尊，太𡻕","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287474714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小運資以次之。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287474714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇本命與大運德合於建旺之鄉，其歲運","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287491098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日時吉而未足為救。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287491098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王氏","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287507482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"注云：五行四柱，或上尊凶而下畀吉者，卑勝尊也。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287507482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下之","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287523866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅上，曰伐也，尅我之謂鬼，故雖救療亦無功也。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287523866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或上尊吉而","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287540250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下界凶，隂陽理順，上之制下，曰治也，我尅之謂財，故雖不藥","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287540250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而自愈也。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287540250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王氏","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287638554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"注云：祿有㑹，如甲祿在寅，遇甲寅，是至祿之㑹，一祿也。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287638554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287654938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287654938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，是暗合天德之㑹，二祿也。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287654938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得甲戊，乃","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287671322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祿堂","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287671322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之㑹。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287671322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"灾有","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287687706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五期者，以三元祿馬五𠁅遇死絶之地者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287687706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一說以太𡻕、","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287704090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月建、日辰、大小運五䖏皆来期㑹，凶殺刑尅本命期期，亦謂","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287704090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之災有五期。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287704090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"趙氏","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287720474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"新注云：如甲祿在寅，遇午戌，亦同建祿，凡五行遇鬼死","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287720474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓絶為災，故云三會五期。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287720474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聞喜不喜，是六甲之虧盈；當憂不憂，賴五行之救助。","logicSentenceId":"7538011398287736858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡女命是子午卯酉日生合嫁子午卯酉命夫四孟、四季日亦","logicSentenceId":"7538016296446394395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同。","logicSentenceId":"7538016296446394395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若嫁日千合，或支神三合、六合者，俱不偕老。","logicSentenceId":"7538016296446410779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"恬裕齋","logicSentenceId":"7538016296446427163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873443453517859"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡女命胎年為福，主夫位榮𩔰；生時為福，主子孫榮𩔰。","logicSentenceId":"7538016296446427163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日時俱","logicSentenceId":"7538016296446443547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為福，受夫與","logicSentenceId":"7538016296446443547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子䕃","logicSentenceId":"7538016296446443547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7538016296446443547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡女命大宜納音上生下，主人有殊福，不宜下尅上，主欺詐僣","logicSentenceId":"7538016296446459931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"越。","logicSentenceId":"7538016296446459931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若年之納音尅時之納音，不宜子。","logicSentenceId":"7538016296446476315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：若年尅戰刑破生時","logicSentenceId":"753801629644649269 {"lines":[{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡女命絶中有生，旺中有死，空亡中有破，五行無情，乃吉婦人","logicSentenceId":"7538016296446509083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7538016296446509083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生中有絕，死中有旺，而帯殺者，賤婦也。","logicSentenceId":"7538016296446525467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡女命日坐年祿榮神者，郡國之封，春甲乙，夏丙丁，秋庚辛、冬","logicSentenceId":"7538016296446541851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸，榮神也。","logicSentenceId":"7538016296446541851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡女命刑衝無情者為上，只無情次之。","logicSentenceId":"7538016296446558235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶夫祿仍有實庫，又次","logicSentenceId":"7538016296446574619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873443453534243"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之，皆命婦格也。","logicSentenceId":"7538016296446574619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡女命貴人帶天、月德、日上有官，乃賢婦人也。","logicSentenceId":"7538016296446591003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡十女命，印要虚，庫要實，五行淡静無情，有福不相帶惹，為上等","logicSentenceId":"7538016296446607387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"清廉之格。","logicSentenceId":"7538016296446607387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一云：凡女命要庫虚而貴實。","logicSentenceId":"7538016296446623771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"co {"lines":[{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡女命帶合多者，不厄。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713860147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妓即","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713876531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妞","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713876531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妾也。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713876531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三、六合天地合亦同論，若","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713892915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更帶貴人，多是上游官妓，不然貴人左右也。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713892915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或有因而受封者，","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713909299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福在日時上也。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713909299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873443453632547"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡女命犯","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713925683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"桃花","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713925683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼者，主少入娼門，老為貧丐。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713925683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713942067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生人在","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713942067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713942067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三月亥時","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713942067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713942067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已酉丑","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713942067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生人在","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713942067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春三月寅時","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713942067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713942067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713942067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生人在","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713942067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏三月","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713942067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已時","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713942067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713942067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥卯未","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713942067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生人在","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713942067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋三月申時","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713942067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713942067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古詩云：桃花與刼兩相侵，不","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713958451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為盗賊犯姦淫。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713958451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然女子𮞸逢着，少入娼門老至貧。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713974835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"並","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"廣信集","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂人命與男子稍異，常欲五行不傷，太過不及，欲得恬和，中有","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713991219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格也。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358713991219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更帶祿馬貴人，自生自旺六合者，主巧性賢德，姿貌殊","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714007603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"麗，不可傷於五行，大盛則恐之桑順，不可傷於死絕，見淫媚而","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714007603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟男。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714007603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟得五行恬和，又緊要福聚集於日時上乃佳。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714023987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖日為夫，","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714040371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時為子也。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714040371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一切福神加於日時上，須因夫子而貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714056755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖隂人之福在於夫與子也，當重貴號，早適賢夫。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714073139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若日時二位","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714089523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"恬裕齋","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714089523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873443453648931"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福力不𦂳，乃常命也。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714089523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如福聚月胎之上，只是生於富貴之家中，","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714105907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不為夫之福也。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714105907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡婦人之命，㝡喜者，是金轝六合自旺，則富厚而利骨肉，見印","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714122291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"綬、祿鬼、水火兩字，或金水兩字，姿質美麗，自生自狂，帶官符或","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714122291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行支干不相徃來，無情，内清白嚴毅有守，不喜淫雜。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714122291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若祿為","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714138675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死絶，則儉素不華，印綬帶殺，則權能任重；六合相生，則骨肉盛","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714138675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"茂，周旋施和美。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714138675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時上見貴人驛馬，多生賢孝之子，孕產無虞。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714155059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714171443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上見之，得","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714171443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賢美","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714171443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聰眀之夫，一生快樂也。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714171443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡婦人之命，下賤者，尤為易定，大忌咸池自敗，大耗天中凌尅，","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714187827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑衝氣散，自刑帯殺，為性塵賤淫蕩，縱有貴格，亦有風聲，更忌。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714187827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873443453665315"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魁罡交衝，則多狼戾不順，或飄蕩，生旺太過，中見刼殺，徃来相","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714204211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衝，為性多烈，不睦六親，却清貞不淫，動招患禍。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714204211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若咸池與大耗","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714220595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同宫，則淫媚讒毒；天中與暴敗相承，則情性多訛，招淫私玷辱。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714220595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有行衝，必至淫私，官事發覺。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714236979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但命見大耗、咸池、天中者，須有","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714253363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不美之事。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714253363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡婦人下格，多是日時上死絕帶殺，不貧則賤；五行生旺大過","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714269747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而帶殺，多貧困作勞，或自營於街市，或塵賤劣庸之婦。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714269747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但五行","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714286131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺者，不至於娼淫之𩔖也。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714286131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡婦人下格中，五行死絕不及者，","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714302515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更帶凶殺刑尅，不娼，則為賤婢。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714302515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命中見無禮刑，或天中印，或合","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714318899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓中天耗者，多是謀巫術藥之輩。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714318899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲干所尅者禄財，𡻕支所尅曰命財，納音所尅曰身財。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714662963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其三","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714679347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財所屬之五行，在命中一財不乏而得之全者，夫必榮，兒必","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714679347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714679347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"切嫌者隂刃，妨害尊親；㝡忌者純隂，不宜子息。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714695731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祿後一辰曰隂刃，男得之，妨妻族親；女得之，妨夫族親。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714712115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又命","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714728499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月日時、支干八字俱属隂，又生五月之後、十一月之前者，","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714728499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃隂極而陽不生，是為純隂多而無子息。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714728499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖獨隂則不成，獨","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714744883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽則不生。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358714744883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻位者，以已身納音𠩄尅者為之，若在有氣之鄉，主得妻賢","logicSentenceId":"7538018358715088947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明婉涉，終身相保。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358715088947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令甲子金人以木為妻，二月生是，餘凖","logicSentenceId":"7538018358715105331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358715105331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在死墓無氣之鄉，則主𠩄娶狼戾惡妬，或即頻多妨尅。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358715121715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873443453780003"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令","logicSentenceId":"7538018358715138099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲","logicSentenceId":"7538018358715138099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌火命，以金為妻，十一月、十二月，主值妻之死墓之","logicSentenceId":"7538018358715138099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月餘此夫位者，以尅我者為夫。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358715138099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫在旺相有氣之鄉，則主","logicSentenceId":"7538018358715154483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得賢夫，有官爵，終身和睦。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358715154483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令甲子命金人以火為夫，五月","logicSentenceId":"7538018358715170867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生逢火旺，餘準此。","logicSenten null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若月上刑衝帶殺，則同袍不和，法眷垂越；更帶大","logicSentenceId":"7538029633717108745","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耗，他須連累；日上刑衝帶殺，則求化元縁，飄流不定；時上刑衝","logicSentenceId":"7538029633717108745","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶殺，則少徒弟，一生窮寂，衣鉢不備也。","logicSentenceId":"7538029633717108745","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡道德之命，亦有等降，命中見印，當權服衆，前䘮後吊，則苦行","logicSentenceId":"7538029633717125129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷身，有華盖夾貴、三奇中帶五行恬和之氣，或帶自死自絶。","logicSentenceId":"7538029633717125129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火","logicSentenceId":"7538029633717141513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木者，志性朗白，清髙脫洒人也。","logicSentenceId":"7538029633717141513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更帶干鬼，倒食學堂，金水則文","logicSentenceId":"7538029633717157897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"章辨慧，生旺太過，則明利之心不可遏。","logicSentenceId":"7538029633717157897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更帶凶殺，終是還俗。","logicSentenceId":"7538029633717174281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡為術命，有長生學堂主本，不帶刑戰傷鬪，有小可福氣，歸於","logicSentenceId":"7538030466859909171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本主，但五行無根本耳。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466859909171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祿後二人，名祿九地，學堂空亡、華盖、印","logicSentenceId":"7538030466859925555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庫，亦主作九流貴人，無用亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466859925555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無根本者，如水人無金，火人無","logicSentenceId":"7538030466859941939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466859941939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不惟九流，但是貴賤人命犯之，主無祖業。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466859958323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遊逸之人。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466859974707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命五行無根本，四柱不相徃來，脫前落後，無情無理，","logicSentenceId":"7538030466859991091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故作飄蓬尋幽之士。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466859991091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更五行無氣象者，破落道人也。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860007475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更刑射破","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860023859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"了主本，即是丐士。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860023859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或五行無根本，却有福德互相徃來者是容。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860040243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吏人命衝刑，多為吏人東西戰闘，南北衝争，長生䖏破了，死敗","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860122163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"䖏生起，五行錯雜者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860122163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若帶官鬼而有福氣，兼引死還生者，","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860138547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是因吏中有禄也。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860138547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若帶刑殺者，多至徒配。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860154931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命帶重支重干，有刑戰者，是狡猾公人也。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860171315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"並","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"廣信集","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七、恬裕齋","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860220467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873443454140451"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兵卒命，局中殺重，方為兵卒。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860220467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行不等，破傷主本，尊卑無禮者","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860236851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦是也。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860236851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若帶福氣凶中有生成主本者，是由軍伍而有權祿人","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860253235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860253235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此等命亦有食，亦有權星，雖貴命而殺在先也。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860269619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"廣信集","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人禀五行之氣而生者也，形貌美惡，性之剛桑不同，由金、木、","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860286003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水、火、土金叙五行形情性。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860286003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860302387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人主骨肉相應，面上濶下狹，眉髙眼深，額平，印堂寛，鼻曲耳","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860302387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅，音聲清亮，剛毅有决，動為尚義。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860302387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死絶則面有岩稜，眼深睛黑，","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860318771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅薄内毒淫喜殺，有拙無志也。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860318771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水人主形貌瘦長，骨細，肉膩口尖，人中長美髮，手足纎膩，柔語","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860335155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873443454156835"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"細聲，其色青，遇火而赤，逢金而白。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860335155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺則仁勇氣即，死絶則眉","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860351539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼不正，慳吝鄙嗇，肌肉乾燥，項長喉結，行坐不稳，身多欹側也。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860351539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水人主眉濃目大，鼻曲面圓，頂平細，生旺黑色，受制黃白，行步","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860367923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"緊速，揺頭擺腰，為性寬大小小急，生旺莽蕩大器，死絶則除狹","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860367923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内狠，帯殺則傾覆隂謀。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860367923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火人主面上尖下濶，印堂窄，鼻露竅，精神閃爍，語言辨急，意速","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860384307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聲焦，其色或青或赤，更變不定，坐須揺膝，立不移時，臨事敏疾。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860384307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如死絕則黃瘦尖小，性靈如毒，有始無終，多𡚶作。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860400691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有貴氣主之，","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860417075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則大聰明。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860417075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土人主形貌肥厚，背圎腰濶，鼻大口方，眼長眉秀，有墻壁，其色","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860433459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873443454173219"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄白，為性重厚，作事不輕，易，容寛愽。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860433459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死絕則顏色似憂，鼻低面","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860449843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"褊，聲音重濁，朴質抝事，孤介吝梗，不容衆情，沉毒恨事也。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860449843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上五行之情，参以吉凶神殺所遇，於命中日時上納音，所","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860466227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得五行，或生或𦔽，或死或絶，自可以推之。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860466227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬者純隂之水，三光不照；丁者藏隂之火，自昧而不明，故丁","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860744755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873443454205987"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬為淫慝之合，主人眼淫神嬌，多情易動，習下無志，耽歡惑","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860744755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色，於我則吝，於彼則貪。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860744755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若五行死絶，或帶殺，見咸池、大耗，天","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860761139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中自敗，是淫巧人也。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860761139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"親小人，慢君子，貪婪妄作，必勝而後已。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860777523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人淫邪奸慝，多招玷辱，或年髙而嫁少壻，或年父而適老","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860793907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫，或先賤而後良，或先良而後賤也。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860793907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊，陽土也，是老醜之夫；癸隂水也，是婆娑之婦。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860826675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"老陽而少隂，","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860843059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖合而無情也。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860843059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主人或好或醜。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860859443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如戊得","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860875827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860875827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，則嬌神色、姿美得","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860875827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所；若","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860875827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860875827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860875827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860875827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，則形貌古朴，老相塵俗。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860875827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若戊合癸，則男子娶好","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860892211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦，婦人嫁美夫；癸合戊，則男子娶老妻，婦人當嫁老夫也。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860892211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462"," {"lines":[{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論人身形，","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860941363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵生旺者主長大，死絕者主矮小，若有殺臨之，則不在","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860941363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此限，又從殺上㫁之也。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860941363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大要木瘦長，金方矮，土肥厚，骨麄，","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860957747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水肥壮，骨細火長，筋骨麄，木青、金白、土黃、水黑火赤。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860957747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860974131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅，則從所尅之五行斷其形狀顔色。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860974131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡㫁此，取日時上納","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860990515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"音，看有尅無尅，并神殺所臨，有氣無氣，㫁其形狀情性，萬","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860990515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不失一也。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466860990515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推人性行","logicSentenceId":"7538030466861006899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此格只日時上看。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命若入格而逢生旺者，主為性明白，遇物不逆，動必應機，","logicSentenceId":"7538030466861006899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"恬裕齋","logicSentenceId":"7538030466861006899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873443454238755"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言語聲髙，豁逹大度，臨事能斷，公正不疑，紀難不畏，平生","logicSentenceId":"7538030466861006899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不以財物為吝，好施與，不私已，奢泰歡樂，多情尚義，平生","logicSentenceId":"7538030466861006899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無滯，常防有不善終之患。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466861006899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若命入貴格而逢死絶者，主為","logicSentenceId":"7538030466861023283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"性寡合，機深意宻，多疑足既，動拘禮節，謹顧行止，修飾儀","logicSentenceId":"7538030466861023283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貌，常自檢約，不妄施設，常防有隂謀之患。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466861023283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若小人之命已","logicSentenceId":"7538030466861039667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入賤局，而逢生𦔽者，主性氣無常，不自尊檢，為事不顧危","logicSentenceId":"7538030466861039667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡，好事鬫持，恃強壓弱，親近惡黨，不事家業，必竟不得善","logicSentenceId":"7538030466861039667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"終也。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466861039667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死絕則為性淫邪，動必巧僞，畜縮執抝，舉動修飾，事","logicSentenceId":"7538030466861056051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弄言辭，好自矜街，臨事無斷，少是多非，一生無主。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466861056051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上如","logicSentenceId":"7538030466861072435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入至貴之格局，其性行一皆如前。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466861072435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若常貴之流，或兼此並。","logicSentenceId":"7538030466861088819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫人禀五行之和氣而成形，所以有疾苦者，皆由隂陽五行之","logicSentenceId":"7538018358978740233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，虚實寒熟，大過不及，贅疣而致也。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358978740233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲知人虛實，死絕為虚，生","logicSentenceId":"7538018358978756617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺為實，虚實既明，疾病可以𩔖推也。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358978756617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凢水死絕，多胷氣腰足攻","logicSentenceId":"7538018358978773001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"疰，滑泄，便溺不利之疾。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358978773001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火死絶，主腸氣結塞，驚悖健忘，精神不","logicSentenceId":"7538018358978789385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"安之疾。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358978789385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木死絶，主虚風目濇眩暈筋急，爪甲枯顇，喜怒顛倒，擇","logicSentenceId":"7538018358978805769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飯揀食之疾。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358978805769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金死絕，主氣虚，喘急咳嗽，皮毛集燥乾嗇，骨節疼","logicSentenceId":"7538018358978822153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"痛，若憂足涕泗泪，大腸瀉痢便血之疾。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358978822153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土死絶，主面黄減食，隔","logicSentenceId":"7538018358978838537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食吐逆，肢躰怠惰，喜睡嗜卧，多思足慮，耳聾神濁，健忘少喜動","logicSentenceId":"7538018358978838537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873443454337059"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作之疾。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358978838537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡五行有相尅而成疾者，金火相尅生旺，則痬瘡癰痛。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358978854921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死絶無","logicSentenceId":"7538018358978871305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，主勞瘵嘔血。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358978871305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土木相尅生旺，主疲悶昏眩風麻，小腸疾癬瘧。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358978887689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死絶相尅，主吐食癥塊，疽癖積滯之疾。","logicSentenceId":"7538018358978904073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"李九万","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"云：木土相尅，主中風土受邪故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫人壽夭修短之數，大抵生旺則為夀長，死絕則為夭折。","logicSentenceId":"7538019764049231881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如根","logicSentenceId":"7538019764049248265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"根深者帶固，源濬者流長。","logicSentenceId":"7538019764049248265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命皆要逢生旺，則為有夀。","logicSentenceId":"7538019764049264649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如日月","logicSentenceId":"7538019764049281033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上逢生旺，時上雖有死氣不妨，盖生旺之氣故也。","logicSentenceId":"7538019764049281033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如月上死絶，","logicSentenceId":"7538019764049297417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日時上雖生旺，氣不甚雄，盖生承死絕故也。","logicSentenceId":"7538019764049297417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於三十𡻕前，雖有","logicSentenceId":"7538019764049313801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幾死之灾。","logicSentenceId":"7538019764049313801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如月日生旺，時上死絶，人夀不過四十五崴；月日時","logicSentenceId":"7538019764049330185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死絕者，死在三十𡻕前也。","logicSentenceId":"7538019764049330185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有凶殺，五行凌犯，必為殤子。","logicSentenceId":"7538019764049346569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常以","logicSentenceId":"7538019764049362953" {"lines":[{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行支干納音，位位相和則蹇剥。","logicSentenceId":"7538020933464227891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如甲子生逢已己在秌","logicSentenceId":"7538020933464244275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生，又見甲午衝命，兩金尅已，已木故凶。","logicSentenceId":"7538020933464244275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱主木，禄馬徃来，須分建破，天乙扶持，將德是衝，更辨尊卑。","logicSentenceId":"7538020933464260659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂當用䖏有建不可破，已破却不可建。","logicSentenceId":"7538020933464277043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉神在四柱中，名用","logicSentenceId":"7538022426316111923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十為貴。","logicSentenceId":"7538022426316111923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有根而無苗實，貧而尚可甘食，本氣純而花繁，縱子成而味拙。","logicSentenceId":"7538022426316128307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"根基本主有氣，雖運不扶合，亦可作平生自足之命。","logicSentenceId":"7538022426316144691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三元四","logicSentenceId":"7538022426316161075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱本無𦔽氣，得到福祿之運，亦不可以久榮。","logicSentenceId":"7538022426316161075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

lineType":1,"content":"盖一月之中，晦朔周而有","logicSentenceId":"7537998256215801902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三十日，","logicSentenceId":"7537998256215801902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一日","logicSentenceId":"7537998256215801902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之内，晝夜周而有十二時。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256215801902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"總十年之運氣，凡","logicSentenceId":"7537998256215818286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三","logicSentenceId":"7537998256215818286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"7537998256215818286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而有三十六","logicSentenceId":"7537998256215818286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"時乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見，三百六十日為一𡻕之數。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256215818286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在一月之","logicSentenceId":"7537998256215834670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中，有三百六十時，折除節氣，算計三千六百日，為一辰之十","logicSentenceId":"7537998256215834670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873444506157108"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256215834670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人生以一百二十𡻕為周天，論折除之法，必有生日實","lo
